notes.title: Catch bugs and fight both sides of the battles in Dicey Bugs - out now
notes.notes:
Dicey Bugs is a cute looking roguelite bug-catching strategy game, it just released from ProdigalSon Games and has Linux / Steam Deck support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/09/catch-bugs-and-fight-both-sides-of-the-battles-in-dicey-bugs-out-now/

notes.title: Try the big demo update for Dicey Bugs, a turn-based deckbuilder where you control both sides
notes.notes:
Dicey Bugs is a roguelike, turn-based deckbuilder where you control both sides of the battles. A new demo is live now!

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/try-the-big-demo-update-for-dicey-bugs-a-turn-based-deckbuilder-where-you-control-both-sides/

notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.notes:
Demo is out now! Go capture adorable creatures, customize your dice, gather resources, and create powerful synergies to be the very best!

Have fun and leave us feedback to continue to make this game the best it can be for you!

Thank you!
